verdict.rationale: Logseq exposes programmatic surfaces you can build against: a plugin API with marketplace and unpacked-plugin loading, an authorized local HTTP APIs server for external access to the graph, and a logseq:// protocol for third-party apps. However, the plugin API docs are described as community-driven, and the evidence never names an official, packaged SDK. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an explicitly official SDK package or library with language bindings, first-party SDK reference documentation, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), and independent hands-on corroboration of building with it.
